Job description

Role & responsibilities

We are looking for a proactive and creative Marketing Executive / Digital Marketing Manager to help grow our online presence and increase sales. The ideal candidate should be organized, results-driven, and experienced in digital marketing and customer engagement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Create and manage product listings across online marketplaces.
  • Develop and implement effective marketing strategies to increase brand awareness and sales.
  • Manage customer inquiries, messages, and responses across all online platforms.
  • Drive online sales through promotional campaigns, advertising, and optimization.
  • Plan, create, and manage social media content across platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and others.
  • Monitor campaign performance and recommend improvements based on data and trends.
  • Coordinate marketing activities to ensure consistent branding and customer engagement.

Requirements

  • Experience in digital marketing, e-commerce, or social media management.
  • Knowledge of online marketplaces and product listing management.
  • Strong communication and customer service skills.
  • Ability to plan and execute marketing campaigns.
  • Familiarity with social media marketing, content creation, and analytics.
  • Self-motivated, organized, and able to work independently.


Preferred candidate profile

  • Experience with Meta Ads, Google Ads, or other digital advertising platforms.
  • Basic graphic design skills (Canva, Photoshop, or similar).
  • Understanding of SEO and online sales optimization.
  • Experience using CRM or e-commerce platforms is an advantage.


Perks and benefits
